 Up to 60% off: What to shop in Philips' Black Friday sale
 Perfect for him and her
 Jessica Smith Senior Health and Wellness Shopping Writer 3 min read November 17, 2026 - 11:00AM This article may contain links from our affiliate and advertising partners. We may receive payments when you click on links, buy through them or share this content.
 These are the best deals on Philips this Black Friday. Picture: Philips More from Sales PSA: You can score $1000 off reformer machines right now 
 ‘Deeply satisfying’: This luxury sex toy brand is up to 50% off 
 Meet the sexy Advent calendar offering $499 of value for $169 
 As we barrel toward Christmas at an alarming rate, it's time to wake up and smell the Black Friday sales.  
 If buying for the man in your life is proving harder than expected (or just as difficult as every other year), a quality shaver is a great way to go. And now, Philips has slashed some of the best by more than half price . Or, if you're after a gift for yourself, you'll also find great deals on everything from a " game-changing" at-home IPL laser hair removal device, now 53 per cent off , to the Sonicare DiamondClean electric toothbrush bundle, now 60 per cent off. 
 The Series i9000 Prestige Ultra Electric Shaver , that reviewers describe as "fabulous" and "amazing in precision" has just been marked down by 60 per cent, to $399 from $999 . Another reviewer writes that "you would have to be rich to justify buying this at full price," and in this economy, they're probably not wrong. So, don't let this deal pass you by — I've covered three Black Fridays in a row now, and I don't see any of these deals sticking around for long. 
 There are great deals on hair removal devices this Black Friday. Image: Amazon Australia If you're looking for a gift under $50, the Philips OneBlade 360 has 13.7k global ratings and has been described as "top quality" by reviewers. It's currently 51 per cent off , down to just $49 from $99 , making it the perfect present that won't totally break the bank. 
 For a gift under $100, the Philips Multigroom 7000 All-in-One 16-Piece Trimmer is now 53 per cent off, down to just $79.90 from $169 . Buyers say it's "versatile, easy to use, and works well for trimming the beard, hair, and body". Meanwhile, another says they're " super impressed ," and that it trims thick hair "effortlessly," while another claims it contains "just about every attachment you could want."
 You'll also find 52 per cent off the Philips Multigroom 9000 All-in-One 20-Piece Trimmer + OneBlade , now $129 from $269. One reviewer calls it "a really versatile grooming kit and has everything I need in one set. "
 We tried the Philips Sonicare Diamond Clean Toothbrush, now on sale. Image: Rebecca Fearn If you're looking for a couples' gift, Philips has slashed 60 per cent off the Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 Black + Pink Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush Bundle Pack , down to just $248 for a pack of two. Our tester found these brushes to be super easy to set up and use, and found the gum health feature to be a " game-changer. " For a couple sharing a bathroom, this pack is a no-brainer. If a bundle pack isn't your style, you'll also find 50 per cent off the singular Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 Rechargeable Sonic Electric Toothbrush , down to $184 from $369.  
 If you're after personal care devices for hair removal, the Philips OneBlade Intimate is down to just $44.90 from $84.95. With 6.8k global ratings , reviewers say it "gives a close trim without irritating my skin, and does e xactly what I was hoping it would. "
 If you're looking to save on razors or wax appointments next year, you'll find 53 per cent off the at-home IPL laser hair removal device that's been described as "an absolute gamechanger " by reviewers, down to $399 from $849 . It has three unique attachments for the body, face and bikini area, and allows you to choose from five manual intensity settings. You’ll also receive a bonus compact pen trimmer to tidy up delicate areas, so it's definitely a multi-use tool. One reviewer says it's "100% worth the money. ...also super easy to use and doesn’t take up much time, especially compared to shaving several times a week." You'll also find the Philips Lady Shaver Series 8000 slashed by 50 per cent and down to just $74.90 . With two speeds, a built-in light and ability to be used wet or dry, reviewers say it's "worth a purchase." 
 Score big deals on at-home IPL devices. Image: Amazon Australia For more Philips deals to shop this Black Friday, keep on reading: 
 48% off the Philips Epilator Series 8000 - Cordless Wet and Dry Electric Epilator, $129 (down from $249) 
 50% off the Philips Shaver i9000 Prestige Electric Shaver (AU Version), $348 (down from $699) 
 35% off the Philips Shaver Series 5000 Wet & Dry Electric Shaver with SkinIQ Technology, $141.90 (down from $209) 
 42% off the Philips Series i9000 Electric Shaver (AU Version) with SkinIQ, $289 (down from $499) 
 55% off the Philips Lumea IPL Hair Removal Device (AU Power Plug) for Men and Women with SmartSkin Sensor & SenseIQ Technology, $469 (down from $1049) 
 When should I start shopping for Black Friday deals? 
 Early Black Friday deals can start from the end of October and run through to the official date of Black Friday, which is 27 November. The best time to shop Black Friday deals is all throughout November, as most brands release deals during this time. It's important to note that not all discounts will stay the same throughout November, so if you see a great deal, it's likely worth adding to cart.
 Will prices drop further during Cyber Monday, or should I buy now? 
 It isn't a guarantee that prices will drop further on Cyber Monday. Due to the high volume of retail activity during November, stock moves quickly, so waiting until Cyber Monday to purchase something on your wishlist could see it disappearing before you get the chance to buy it. If you spot a great deal on something you like, we recommend jumping on it while stocks last.

 Jessica Smith Senior Health and Wellness Shopping Writer Jessica has been covering lifestyle content for four years and previously worked as a content writer for news.com.au, covering everything from health insurance to camping hacks. Jessica holds a Bachelor's Degree in Digital Media, and has bylines across news.com.au, checkout, Escape and Body+Soul, where she now holds the title of Senior Health and Wellness Shopping Writer. Most of her time is spent testing and researching all things skincare, activewear and wellness, to help Australians find the products they'll truly love. She is a pilates fanatic, a keen traveller, and an open book ready to share anything and everything about her best recommendations, because there’s no gatekeeping here.
